newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia corn output set to rise to 9.2m tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia corn output set to rise to 9.2m tonnes.

text.p: Indonesia's domestic corn production is projected to rise to 9.2 million tonnes this year against 8.9 million tonnes last year, the Jakarta Post reported on Wednesday.

The paper quoted Agriculture Minister Sjarifudin Baharsjah as saying on Monday that production would increase because the area planted with hybrid corn would expand to 1.2 million hectares this year from 500,000 hectares last year.
"Corn crop expansion projects are planned for six provinces: North Sumatra, Lampung, West Java, Central Java, East Java and South Sulawesi," the newspaper said. It gave no other details.

The report said Indonesia imported about one million tonnes of mainly hybrid corn annually for domestic poultry feed. Corn makes up to 50 percent of poultry feed, which includes about 15 percent soybean.
It said poultry husbandry has grown in Indonesia in line with increased demand for meat, milk and eggs in recent years because of a strengthening economy.
The Federation of Indonesian Feedmillers said in November Indonesia aimed to end corn imports by 1999 with the introduction of the hybrid corn.
